summary: Segmented control whose selection pill is driven by two springs, so it stretches between options and recolours labels exactly where it covers them.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selected label. Use with `onValueChange`. A label that is not in `options` selects the first option.

props.name: options
props.description: Option labels. Each label is also the option's value.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the radio group.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when the user picks a different option by click or arrow key. Changing `value` from outside does not call it.

keyboard.action: Select and focus the next option, wrapping at the end.
Select and focus the previous option, wrapping at the start.

accessibility: The root has `role="radiogroup"` and an `aria-label` from `label`; options are native buttons with `role="radio"` and `aria-checked`.
Roving tabindex: only the selected option is in the tab order.
The pill and a second, recoloured label layer used for the pill effect are `aria-hidden`.
motion: With reduced motion the pill jumps to the selected option without the spring stretch.
notes: The control is as wide as its options. Give it a width (`className="w-full"`) to stretch the track; the options stay at the start.
Changing `options` snaps the pill to the selected option without animating.
